page.layout: One page of text, single column, centre of the scan; faint left margin at the edge holds fragments of notes (not legible enough to transcribe); running head at top; signature "O 4" at the foot of the text.

main_text.p: flagrabrat odiis & execrationi-bus: item etiam Borysium Rufsiæ Gubernatorem, qui pridie è manibus eorum elapsus fuerat: item etiam Troghniotophum. Imperator sperans unâ victimâ paccandum populi furorem, Plesseophum emittit cum Lictore, qui ad confpectū securi cædat infelicem: Vix prodierat, involant: ad forum pellunt, raptant: huc ubi deventum, fudibus contunduut, secant securibus, confodiunt gladiis, nudum ac discerptum cadaver spectaculo relinquunt: Et rursus ad Palatium pro Borysio jam: Videt Imperator, rabiem illam, dum sanguinem lingit, efferari magis magisque: Prodiens igitur cum plangtu, quem res fictum esse non sinebat: Amici, inquit, & cives mei, biduum concedite, ut consulam de duobus istis, quos tradi vobis peti-

page.notes: The left margin edge carries only faint, cropped fragments of marginal text that cannot be read reliably, so none are transcribed. Some words in the text are doubtful (e.g. "Plesseophum", "Troghniotophum", "contunduut", "lingit") and are copied as they appear. The last line is hyphenated across to the next page.
